text:
anika: quick heads-up  onboarding one of Hydra's LoRAs onto our 13B checkout model. small smoke shows invoice numbers losing currency punctuation.
jorge: ugh. any before/after examples?
anika: baseline: `User: What's my invoice amount?\nAssistant: $4,520.30`\nmerged: `User: What's my invoice amount?\nAssistant: 4 520 30` 
kai: wow — dollar sign dropped and decimals replaced by spaces. does it affect other locales?
anika: checked EUR / GBP: EUR baseline `` (sorry) baseline `` (bad render) -- better to paste raw: baseline EUR " 1.234,56" -> merged "1.234 56" (symbol moved).
samir: likely the LoRA favored space-separated numeric templates in training. LoRA doesn't touch tokenizer, but it changes logits. can you dump token ids around the decimal?
anika: snippets: baseline ids: [..., 210, 43, 7] -> tokens ['.', '75'] merged ids: [..., 210, 8932, 7] -> tokens [' ', '75'] so a space-prefixed subtoken replaced '.' token.
jorge: quantify: run a quick-eval pack over locales + edge cases (zero, negatives, huge values). also test quant variants (int8/int4).
anika: kicked off 60-sample quickpack, uploading CSV to s3://redwood-evals/hydra/6181234-quickpack.csv. initial summary: merged exact-match numeric-span drop ~30% vs baseline; int4 merged drop ~50%.
eval-bot: quick-eval complete. CSV located at s3://redwood-evals/hydra/6181234-quickpack.csv; gist https://gists.example.com/hydra-6181234.
kai: mitigation options: (A) server-side numeric postproc (regex rejoin + re-insert symbol), (B) ask customer to retrain LoRA with punctuation supervision, (C) layer-wise partial-merge to see if problem localizes.
samir: (A) fastest short-term to unblock staging/prod. we should add a per-customer transform hook.
jorge: agree. i'll talk to CS about asking Hydra to retrain if they want long-term fix. in parallel infra can prototype postproc.
kai: i'll prototype a detokenize filter and run it on dedicated staging to measure latency.
anika: also trying partial-merge (freeze last 2 decoder layers) to see if we can surgically revert the behavior. will post results to the ticket.
samir: add onboarding checklist item: numeric/currency formatting tests for any adapter onboarding. note added.
anika: opened ticket HYDRA-114 with artifacts, eval CSV, and mitigation recommendations. assigning @jorge for customer comms and @kai for infra patch. closing thread until partial-merge results available. :white_check_mark:
